scope: Additive TH18 regular Wizard L1-L14 direct-parent and normal-splash baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3 for the current parent table; the corroborating splash table does not publish a client build.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
sources.limitations: Announces new troop levels at TH18 but does not list a Wizard level, its numbers, splash radius or timing.

sources.title: Wizard — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports L1-L14 HP/DPS, 4 housing, ground-and-air targeting, no preferred target, 1.5-second cadence, 3-tile range, speed 16 and qualitative ranged splash. It supplies no numeric splash radius, projectile trajectory, collision, wind-up or fixed-tick contract.

sources.title: Wizard
sources.limitations: Reports the same L1-L14 table and a 0.3-tile area splash radius affecting ground and air. It provides no current client-build identifier, projectile speed, launch/impact delay, hitbox or target-tie contract.

splash_radius_tiles.note: The current secondary documentation quantifies the ordinary Wizard area splash; Core already resolves catalogue splash through its shared deterministic projectile impact path.

support.note: The L1-L14 ranged parent, its documented ground-and-air target set, and the 0.3-tile normal splash use shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL paths.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent with qualitative splash but an unquantified normal splash radius.
changed_values.replacement: Shared Core activates a 0.3-tile normal splash and classifies the L1-L14 parent as executable.
changed_values.justification: Current secondary sources agree on the parent table and qualitative splash; the corroborating table supplies the radius. No projectile speed, timing, collision or targeting rule is introduced.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines Wizard projectile speed, launch origin, impact delay, attack wind-up, collision, target loss, target ties, same-tick ordering or the exact splash-boundary metric.
No consulted source defines altitude interaction at the splash boundary beyond the secondary statement that the area attack affects ground and air targets.
The current exact values and 0.3-tile radius are secondary; no primary public quantitative Wizard combat contract was found.
conclusion: Wizard L1-L14 is executable through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a ranged, no-preference parent with a 0.3-tile normal splash. Projectile, geometry, timing, collision and visual fidelity remain partial.
